purpose: Freeze the minimal T12-owned outputs later tasks may consume without allowing T12 to implement those downstream systems.

global_rules: Downstream consumers may read stable T12 outputs but cannot make purchase/VIP/premium-spend state a T12 eligibility input.
T12 never calls downstream difficulty, persistence, economy or region-authoring mutators as part of level eligibility.
Region owners may register accepted completion hooks for their own content; T12 validates/binds those hooks without authoring their content.
A downstream task needing a new T12 output must use a structured interface/change request rather than editing T12-owned runtime from a foreign workstream.
